label: Town of Mendon
header:
# Town of Mendon municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 14; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Mendon's three selectboard members as Megan Smith (Chair), Seth Bridge, and Sarah Buxton
Town of Mendon, 2025 Town Report: the 'Elected Town Officers' table seats Megan Smith (Chair, to 2028), Sarah Buxton (to 2027), and Seth Bridge (to 2029)

Town of Mendon (official website), Selectboard page: the town's current Selectboard page seats Seth Bridge as Vice Chair; his three-year seat was the one on the 2026 ballot, where he was the sole printed candidate
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (elected town moderator, one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Mendon, 2025 Town Report: Christopher Corsones held the moderator's office in 2025 and was the sole printed candidate on the March 3, 2026 ballot, but no post-meeting source reachable seats him after March 2026, so he is not minted

Town of Mendon, 2025 Town Report: the 'Appointed Town Officers' table lists the Town Clerk as an appointed office (three-year appointed term) held by Jesse Bridge; Mendon has adopted an appointed clerk under 17 V.S.A. section 2651e, and the 2026 warning elects no clerk
Town of Mendon (official website), directory: the town's current directory styles Jesse Bridge Town Clerk

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Jesse Bridge as Mendon's town clerk (name concordant; mode is appointed per the town report)

Town of Mendon, 2025 Town Report: the 'Appointed Town Officers' table lists the Town Treasurer as an appointed office (three-year appointed term) held by Jesse Bridge; Mendon has adopted an appointed treasurer under 17 V.S.A. section 2651f, and the 2026 warning elects no treasurer
Town of Mendon (official website), directory: the town's current directory styles Jesse Bridge Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Jesse Bridge as Mendon's town treasurer (name concordant; mode is appointed per the town report)
Town of Mendon, 2025 Town Report: the 'Elected Town Officers' table seats Nancy Bridge Merrill as Collector of Delinquent Taxes (elected, three-year term to 2028); the 2025 ballot concurs

Town of Mendon, 2025 Town Report: the 'Appointed Town Officers' table lists the Constable as an appointed office held by Mark Fiore (appointed January 2026, succeeding Lema Carter, who resigned January 2026)
Town of Mendon (official website), directory: styles Mark Fiore 'Mendon's Constable/Director of Public Safety'
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Mendon justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024

Town of Mendon, 2025 Town Report: the report's justice of the peace block names the same seven (in short forms: 'Betsy Reddy' for Elizabeth Reddy and 'Al Wakefield' for J. Alvin Wakefield; the certified listing's full forms are recorded)

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Mendon justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Rich Carlson, Susannah Loffredo, Lindsey MacCuaig, Elizabeth Reddy, James Reddy, Megan Smith, and J. Alvin Wakefield. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded
Town of Mendon, 2025 Town Report: the report's justice of the peace block names the same seven
